prayerExcerpt.en-US: He was favored with the gift of miracles, and while preaching in his native Spanish was understood in various languages.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Foi favorecido com o dom dos milagres, e, enquanto pregava em seu espanhol nativo, era compreendido em várias línguas.

meta.face: A Valencian of about forty, lean and grave, with a sallow olive complexion and an INVERTED-TRIANGLE face after Zurbarán's portrait — a BROAD, smooth forehead and wide temples narrowing sharply along FLAT, hollow cheeks to a NARROW, POINTED chin; a LONG, straight nose with a slightly BROADENED tip, HEAVY upper lids LOWERED over dark eyes, STRAIGHT, dark brows set LOW and close above them, a small, thin, downturned mouth; black hair hidden under the hood; a THIN dark moustache and a SMALL, sparse, pointed tuft of beard on the chin; the look withdrawn and recollected. Not the long, full-oval, clean-shaven vincent_ferrer, the soft, heavy-lidded, long-oval thomas_villanova, the square-round peter_verona, or the rectangular, grey-goateed robert_bellarmine.
meta.basis: Zurbarán's St. Louis Bertrand (Wikipedia's lead image, crop in `crops.jpg`) gives a narrow, triangular face under the black hood, lowered eyes, a thin moustache and a small beard. Cartagena is where he landed and first preached (Wikipedia); the Colombian patronage is from Spanish Wikipedia.
